briefing: Markets slipped modestly today, with the NASDAQ down 0.9% and the S&P 500 down 0.4%, a neutral, slightly soft session rather than a sell-off. Cash is $445.88, below the $500 buy threshold, so there are 3 open slots but not enough cash to fill one. Following past lessons, I'm holding all 7 positions and keeping the cash for a clear risk-on day; stop-losses and profit targets will handle exits automatically.

daily_lesson.explanation_en: "Dry powder" means cash an investor keeps on hand so they can act when a good opportunity appears. On a quiet or slightly down day, holding that cash instead of forcing a trade keeps you flexible. When the market turns strongly positive, you can use it to buy your best ideas.
daily_lesson.explanation_zh: 「乾火藥」（Dry Powder）是指投資者手上保留的現金，以便在出現好機會時能即時出手。在市況平淡或輕微下跌的日子，保留現金而不勉強入市，可以保持操作上的彈性。待市場轉為明確偏強時，便可動用這筆資金買入最有把握的標的。

market_education.summary_en: Stocks drifted lower today, and technology-heavy names fell more than the broad market, with the NASDAQ down 0.9% against 0.4% for the S&P 500. No news headlines were supplied for this session, so a specific cause can't be named; the pattern looks like routine profit-taking in growth stocks rather than a reaction to a major event. Several large tech and AI-linked names such as NVDA, AMD and SMCI are trading below their 20-day averages, which supports the view that momentum in that group is cooling for now.
market_education.summary_zh: 今日美股窄幅回落，科技股跌幅較大盤明顯，納指下跌0.9%，標普500則跌0.4%。本次未有提供相關新聞標題，因此無法指出具體催化因素；從走勢判斷，較似是資金在成長股上的例行獲利回吐，而非對重大消息的反應。NVDA、AMD及SMCI等大型科技及AI概念股均已跌穿20日均線，顯示該板塊動能短期內有所降溫。
